description: This file defines classes and methods related to profiling tools, including factory methods for creating profilers, and specific implementations for different profiling tools such as pprof, perf, sample, iprofiler. It appears to be part of a larger system for performance profiling.

classes.name: ProfilerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating profiler instances based on platform and profiler name.

classes.name: Profiler
classes.description: Base class for profiling tools, providing common interface and initialization.

classes.name: SingleFileOutputProfiler
classes.description: Subclass of Profiler that manages output files for profiling reports.

classes.name: GooglePProf
classes.description: Profiler implementation for Google Performance Profiler, outputs a profile report.

classes.name: Perf
classes.description: Profiler implementation for Linux 'perf' tool, supports attaching to process and generating reports.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Profiler implementation for sampling profiling, attaches to process and collects data.

classes.name: IProfiler
classes.description: Profiler implementation for iprofiler, collects detailed profiling data.

methods.name: create_profiler
methods.description: Creates a profiler instance based on platform and profiler name.

methods.name: default_profiler_name
methods.description: Returns default profiler name for a platform.

methods.name: profilers_for_platform
methods.description: Returns list of available profilers for a given platform.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes profiler classes with necessary parameters.

methods.name: attach_to_pid
methods.description: Attaches profiler to a process ID.

methods.name: profile_after_exit
methods.description: Processes profiling data after process exit.

methods.name: _find_unused_filename
methods.description: Finds an unused filename in a directory with a given extension.

methods.name: _first_ten_lines_of_profile
methods.description: Extracts first ten lines of profile output for display.

methods.name: attach_to_pid
methods.description: Attaches perf or other profilers to a process ID.

methods.name: profile_after_exit
methods.description: Generates report after profiling session ends.
